lines.zh: 缓缓移动着它的巨大身躯
lines.en: It moves its massive body slowly.

lines.zh: 摇动它的尾部，发出低沉声
lines.en: It sways its tail, making a low sound.

lines.zh: 用强壮的尾巴扫过地面
lines.en: It sweeps its strong tail across the ground.
It chews on the new food it found.

lines.zh: 我拖着肚子，在沙上慢慢挪。
lines.en: Belly low, I shuffle slowly over the sand.
It enjoys a warm sunbath.
It searches for new territory boundaries.

lines.zh: 用锐利的牙齿啃食树叶
lines.en: It chews on leaves with its sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 慢慢转动头部观察四周
lines.en: It slowly turns its head to look around.

lines.zh: 移动时发出轻微的嘶嘶声
lines.en: It makes a slight hissing sound while moving.

lines.zh: 背上的帆状脊投下长影。
lines.en: My sail throws a long shadow in the sun.

lines.zh: 四条短腿撑着身子挪动。
lines.en: Four short legs carry my heavy body.
My claws scrape the sand for shade.

lines.zh: 尾巴在地上拖出一道沟。
lines.en: My tail drags a groove in the ground.

lines.zh: 侧过身子，让脊背迎着风。
lines.en: I turn my sail into the wind.
It lazily lies on the sandy ground.

lines.zh: 用粗糙的皮肤享受阳光
lines.en: It enjoys the sun with its rough skin.

lines.zh: 用强壮的前肢支撑身体
lines.en: It supports its body with strong front limbs.

lines.zh: 偶尔摆动尾部驱赶苍蝇
lines.en: It occasionally swishes its tail to get rid of flies.

lines.zh: 用尖锐的脊棘展示威慑
lines.en: It uses its sharp spines to show dominance.
It quietly basks in the sun.

lines.zh: 用舌头舔舐身上的鳞片
lines.en: It licks its scales with its tongue.

lines.zh: 背上的帆，迎着风张开了。
lines.en: The sail on my back opens to the wind.
It lazily naps.
It fans away mosquitoes with its tail.
My sail stands up and soaks the sun.
I open my mouth and pant slowly.

lines.zh: 趴在温热的石头上不动。
lines.en: I lie still on a warm stone.
A bug lands on my sail; I flick my tail.
Jaws half open, I wait for something to pass.

lines.zh: 我的帆迎着光，边缘发红。
lines.en: My sail catches the light, edges reddening.

lines.zh: 用锐利的眼睛观察玩家
lines.en: It observes the player with sharp eyes.
It warns the player with its spines.
It swipes at the player with its tail.

lines.zh: 发出警告声让玩家退后
lines.en: It makes a warning sound to make the player back off.
It tries to touch the player with its front claws.
It makes a hissing sound with its teeth.
It gently taps the player with its tail.
It stares at the player with its eyes.
It licks the player's hand with its tongue.

lines.zh: 我抬起前身，把帆撑到最高。
lines.en: I rear up and raise my sail high.

lines.zh: 你踩进了我画下的边界。
lines.en: You stepped inside the line I marked.

lines.zh: 我呼气，背脊跟着颤了一下。
lines.en: I exhale and my sail shivers.
Do not reach out; my teeth are not gentle.

lines.zh: 先看清我的背脊再靠近。
lines.en: Look at my sail before you come closer.

lines.zh: 你身上有肉味，也有铁味。
lines.en: You smell of meat and of iron.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我的头就转一分。
lines.en: Each step you retreat, my head turns a fraction.

lines.zh: 太阳在我这边，你那边是影子。
lines.en: The sun is on my side; yours is shadow.
When I move, the sand speaks.
Will you feed me, or provoke me?

lines.zh: 背帆被打得塌下去一角。
lines.en: One corner of my sail has been struck down.
Ouch, it hurts.
Ouch, that really hurts!
This pain, it's unbearable!
This pain, it's unbearable!
This hurts, needs help!
Injured, in unbearable pain!
This wound, it hurts!
Injured, very painful!
Injured, really hurts!

lines.zh: 好奇的盯着你，摇动尾巴示意接近。
lines.en: Staring at you curiously, swaying the tail to indicate approach.

lines.zh: 嗅嗅你带来的肉块，流露出渴望的眼神。
lines.en: Sniffing the meat you brought, looking longingly at you.

lines.zh: 低吼一声，用头骨轻碰你。
lines.en: Rumbles, gently bumping you with its skull.

lines.zh: 露出锋利的牙齿，盯着食物，等待机会。
lines.en: Showing sharp teeth, staring at the food, waiting for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 缓缓靠近，尾巴轻扫地面，示意友好。
lines.en: Slowly approaching, swishing the tail, indicating friendliness.

lines.zh: 用背部的鳞片摩擦你，表示信任。
lines.en: Rubbing its scales against you, showing trust.

lines.zh: 用尾巴触碰你的手，请求抚摸。
lines.en: Tapping its tail on your hand, asking for petting.

lines.zh: 啃食你递给的肉块，满足地摇尾。
lines.en: Chomping on the meat you gave, wagging its tail contently.

lines.zh: 轻触你的肩膀，表示想成为伙伴。
lines.en: Gently touching your shoulder, indicating a desire to be a companion.

lines.zh: 围着你转圈，发出呼噜声表示高兴。
lines.en: Circling you, making happy rumbles.
Put the meat down; I will take it myself.
Crouch down and I will not bite.

lines.zh: 背脊变色了，你看出来了吗？
lines.en: My sail changed color; do you see it?
One more step and I will show my teeth.

lines.zh: 这片沙地归我，也归你站一会儿。
lines.en: This sand is mine, and yours to stand on briefly.

lines.zh: 我认识你的手，喂过我的那只。
lines.en: I know your hand, the one that fed me.

lines.zh: 别摸背脊中间，那里最烫。
lines.en: Do not touch the middle of my sail; it is hottest.

lines.zh: 突然出现，用巨大尾巴撞击你。
lines.en: Appears suddenly, using its massive tail to collide with you.

lines.zh: 愤怒时，用头部猛烈撞击地面。
lines.en: Collides the ground with its head in anger.

lines.zh: 用坚硬的脊骨猛烈撞击，试图吓退威胁。
lines.en: Rocks its hard spine to intimidate threats.

lines.zh: 用尾巴撞击，试图将你击退。
lines.en: Collides with its tail, trying to push you back.

lines.zh: 用坚硬的尾巴撞击敌人，试图击倒。
lines.en: Collides with its hard tail, trying to knock down the enemy.

lines.zh: 在战斗中用头部撞击敌人。
lines.en: Collides with its head in battle.

lines.zh: 用坚硬的背部骨骼撞击，发出沉重的声音。
lines.en: Collides its hard backbones, producing a heavy sound.

lines.zh: 用脊骨猛烈撞击，试图阻止入侵者。
lines.en: Rocks its spine to stop intruders.

lines.zh: 用尾巴猛烈撞击，试图吓退潜在威胁。
lines.en: Collides with its tail to scare off potential threats.

lines.zh: 在争斗中用头部猛烈撞击对方。
lines.en: Collides with its head in the struggle.
Making a deep mating call.

lines.zh: 用尾巴轻触对方，示意配对。
lines.en: Tapping the other with its tail, indicating mating.

lines.zh: 用锋利的牙齿轻咬对方，表示亲近。
lines.en: Gently biting the other with its sharp teeth, showing intimacy.

lines.zh: 围着对方转圈，发出求偶声。
lines.en: Circling the other, making mating calls.
Rumbles, gently bumping the other with its skull.

lines.zh: 用坚硬的背部骨骼轻敲对方，表示好感。
lines.en: Gently tapping the other with its hard backbones, showing affection.

lines.zh: 用尾巴摩擦对方，表示亲密。
lines.en: Rubbing the other with its tail, showing intimacy.

lines.zh: 发出求偶声，轻触对方的下巴。
lines.en: Making mating calls, gently touching the other’s chin.

lines.zh: 用尖锐的牙齿轻咬，表示亲近。
lines.en: Gently biting with its sharp teeth, showing intimacy.

lines.zh: 把尾巴绕过来，与我并行。
lines.en: Bring your tail around and walk beside me.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，你递来一块肉。
lines.en: Hisss. You offer a piece of meat.

lines.zh: 你递来食物，我感到安心。
lines.en: You give me food, I feel at ease.
I smell the food.

lines.zh: 咀嚼着你的肉，我很满意。
lines.en: Chewing your meat, I’m satisfied.

lines.zh: 享受我给你带来的保护。
lines.en: Enjoy the protection I provide.
The food you gave me is delicious.
Happy to see you feed me.
Enjoy this delicious meat.
Grateful for the food you give.

lines.zh: 这食物对我来说很重要。
lines.en: This food is important to me.
Notice your approach.

lines.zh: 我四条短腿已经扎进沙里。
lines.en: My four short legs are planted in the sand.

lines.zh: 我把背帆立起来，晒足了热。
lines.en: I raise my sail, full of stored heat.
You’re getting close, I’m attacking.
Target identified, I’m ready.
Target locked, ready to strike.
Noticing you, I’ll attack.
Your threat makes me alert.
I see you, ready to attack.
I sense your threat.
Align with my sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 我背上的帆一竖，就是在量你。
lines.en: My sail rises when I size you up.
I’m targeting you.
Eyes on you.
Lock, aim, attack.
Target and attack.
My gaze is on you.
Target locked, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 背帆立起来，下一步就是扑。
lines.en: My sail rises. The pounce comes next.

lines.zh: 我把背帆压低，牙先露出来。
lines.en: I lower my sail and bare my teeth first.
Open wide, roar loudly!
Tail swings, threatening all!
Sharp teeth bite, meat flies!
Sssss, closing in on prey.
Sharp teeth, deadly strike!
Raging roar, prey trapped.
Warning growl, nowhere to hide.
Sharp screech, fear invades.
Sharp teeth tear, blood splatters.
Roar after roar, prey trapped.
I'll guard this territory!
Young ones here, watch them!
Find food, stay alive!
bask in the sun, feel warmth!
Avoid enemies, safety first!
Wander in the territory, hunt prey.
Skeletons drop, pick with care.
Dimetrodon meat, delicious!
Tame me, be friends!
Protect young, ensure survival.

lines.zh: 沙土鼓起一块，我爬了出来。
lines.en: The sand bulges; I claw my way out.

lines.zh: 我甩掉背上的土，撑起脊帆。
lines.en: I shake off the dirt and raise my sail.
On fire, run!
Fell, ouch!
Drowned, went down!
Boom, injured!
Hit, it hurts!
Magic hit, injured!
Starved, weak!
Lightning hit, injured!
Void, dead!
